identity.name: Event Primary Media
identity.definition: Exactly one selected event-detail primary asset or presentation fallback in a prominent frame, optionally acting as the opener for a separately owned viewer.
identity.identity_limit: The identity ends at the image-or-fallback frame and viewer opener; EventHero decisions/actions and Desktop page composition remain outside.

semantic_role: Primary event-detail image-or-fallback frame with semantic fit and optional viewer-open behavior.
explicit_non_goals: Media ingestion, semantic classification or primary-asset selection.
Event title, metadata, ticket, calendar, share, like or page-family routing.
Poster companion, preview rail, viewer dialog, EventCard, listing media or social asset generation.
A global aspect-ratio, crop, spacing or typography token.
An arbitrary consumer fit, object-position or overlay escape hatch.

anatomy.role: Native viewer opener when a valid viewer binding exists
Presentation fallback mutually exclusive with primary image

slots.content_contract: Presentation-only typed or consumer generic fallback; no event-media mutation.
Decorative only, aria-hidden, with no interactive descendants.

semantic_media_modes.definition: Positively identified or reviewed no-text event visual.
Portrait source carrying meaningful authored text or poster identity.

semantic_media_modes.fit_contract: Contain and preserve all meaningful content.

semantic_media_modes.definition: Missing, stale, pending or errored semantic certainty.

semantic_media_modes.fit_contract: Render typed or generic presentation fallback; no crop.

props.name: asset
constraints: Exactly one normalized selected asset or null.

props.name: alt
constraints: Non-empty when asset is meaningful; null only with no asset.

props.name: consumer_frame_policy
constraints: Registered contexts only; no raw ratio override.

props.name: viewer_binding
constraints: Fields are atomic and resolve to a separate EventMediaViewer.

props.name: media_decision
constraints: Resolver-produced; must not contradict semantic mode.

props.name: intrinsic_width
constraints: Forward exact source dimension when known.

props.name: intrinsic_height
constraints: Forward exact source dimension when known.

props.name: load_priority
constraints: Primary is eager/high in current event-detail consumers.

defaults.reason: Fallback when no sanitized recommended position exists.
Primary media is the page LCP candidate.
A static frame is valid when no viewer exists.

valid_combinations: Available visual-only + cover + sanitized object position or center.
Available OCR/text/unknown + contain + centered object position.
No image + exactly one typed or generic presentation fallback.
Viewer opener + complete dialog id/index/accessible name binding.
invalid_combinations: Asset present together with no-image state.
Missing asset with cover or crop decision.
OCR/document, textual artwork, portrait poster or unknown mode with cover.
Semantic error reinterpreted as visual-only cover.
Partial viewer binding or opener without resolvable dialog.
Fallback inserted into image_assets, gallery order, metadata or share payload.
2:3 source geometry promoted to a universal frame token.
Empty alt for a meaningful primary image.

responsive_container_behavior.container_contract: Visual photo frame is 16:10 and height-bounded; poster is intrinsic/height-bounded contain; fallback is height-bounded.
responsive_container_behavior.source_art_direction: No alternate source is selected by the component.

responsive_container_behavior.container_contract: Viewport/stage and source-ratio driven; visual may cover and protected media contains.
responsive_container_behavior.source_art_direction: Current route switches DOM at 1024px but does not prove alternate-source art direction.

responsive_container_behavior.container_contract: Viewport cover for visual and viewport/natural contain for protected media; preview rail is outside.
responsive_container_behavior.source_art_direction: No alternate source is selected by the component.

ratio_policy.policy: Source geometry and registered consumer frame policy coexist; repetition never creates a global token.

consumer_policies.selection: Select by semantic mode, not orientation alone.
Container and page composition own dimensions.
Semantic mode chooses cover versus contain; no fixed family ratio.

crop_contain_policy.crop_permission: event-detail product exception; semantic boxes may refine position but are not required to remove bands
crop_contain_policy.reason: Current hero/gallery requirement explicitly fills visual-only media.

crop_contain_policy.crop_permission: crop forbidden until positive semantics exist
crop_contain_policy.reason: Unknown and semantic error fail closed.

focal_safe_area_behavior: Accept only sanitized recommended_object_position; otherwise center.
Pixel-current face/value geometry may refine a resolver result; stale geometry_pixel_sha256 cannot authorize crop.
Protected contain ignores focal positioning and centers the complete image.
The explicit visual-only event-detail cover policy is not silently replaced by the stricter compact-card crop solver.
upscaling_policy: Hide a weak photo only when the same event has a technically strong photo alternative.
Preserve all weak sources when no stronger alternative exists; never drop positively classified posters/documents through photo quality filtering.
A sole low-resolution portrait uses intrinsic-bounded contain.
No universal no-upscale policy is proven for other current primary visuals; preserve current container-fill behavior and keep EM-TINY-005 open.

loading_skeleton_policy.loading: Primary uses eager loading, high fetch priority and async decode.
loading_skeleton_policy.skeleton: No standalone or animated primary skeleton is required by current SSG evidence.
loading_skeleton_policy.layout_reservation: Forward intrinsic dimensions and preserve registered container geometry; applicability remains unproven for every slot.

missing_broken_policy.missing: Resolve typed EventFallbackArt when eligible, otherwise consumer generic fallback.
missing_broken_policy.broken: Candidate requirement: transition to the generic fallback without navigation failure and disable viewer opening for the failed source.

accessibility_requirements: Meaningful image alt uses authored event image alt or an event-title fallback.
A viewer opener is a native button with a specific accessible name and optional live closed-hero status description.
Static no-image frame exposes concise context while decorative fallback content remains aria-hidden.
No nested interactive control; keyboard activation remains native.
Any busy state must clear on both load and error.

constraints: May size container but cannot bypass semantic fit.
Must not enter event media metadata.
Forbidden because it bypasses semantic provenance.

composes: candidate.event-fallback-art when typed missing fallback resolves
consumer_owned: container dimensions and registered frame policy

required_tests.assertion: Visual-only covers; OCR/text/unknown and semantic error contain.
Stale pixel geometry cannot authorize a crop.
Computed fit and dimensions match each registered consumer at 320, 390, 721, 1024, 1366, 1536 and 1920.
Exactly one image or fallback renders.
Broken primary converges to generic fallback and viewer is disabled.
Alt, opener name, keyboard activation and busy terminal state are correct.
Photo, poster, low-resolution and no-image specimens preserve geometry.
Protected cover, global ratio and consumer internal override mutations fail.

steps: Add a normalized adapter over existing EventHero and DesktopEventPage inputs without changing output.
Build isolated candidate specimens and shadow-compare DOM, computed fit, geometry and accessibility.
Opt in one consumer at a time only after owner acceptance and candidate-code gates.
Retain current implementations until candidate conformance and promotion gates pass.
compatibility: Preserve the exact events-bot-new data shape and source semantics at the pinned evidence commit.
Use per-consumer adapters and opt-in only after a separately accepted contract; do not start migration from this artifact.

strategy: Switch each consumer back to its existing internal primary renderer.
Keep old markup and controller paths until migrated consumer count is proven zero.
Remove the candidate package without altering exported event/media data.
trigger_conditions: Candidate DOM, accessibility, media-fit, loading or fallback conformance regresses.
A changed contract hash invalidates earlier candidate evidence.
